messages:
maria: Rehearsal note — main camera dropped feed for ~3s; probable auto-focus motor hiccup. If it dies live well switch to ceiling cam and route slides as PiP.

jordan: Ceiling cam is ready on input 2. Ill swap sources on the encoder; prefer to keep the main stream URL live and change the source rather than restarting the stream.

sachin: Mic gain was clipping on the CEO mic during the practice Q&A. Ive reduced gain by -6dB and enabled a 48hz high-pass. If levels still clip, well hot-swap to the lav and mute main for ~1s.

elaine: Q&A process reminder: ask attendees to post questions in the shared sheet. Ill triage live. For roadmap clarifications please tag the question with "roadmap" so PMs can pick it up. Who is owning follow-ups?

marta: Ill own leadership Qs and follow-ups. Tag items with #allhands-followup and assign to me for first pass. If it needs engineering, tag @sachin; for product clarification tag @jordan.

ops-bot: Reminders scheduled: T-10m post Q&A doc link, T-5m attendee nudge, T-2m ops readiness check in this thread.

maria: Recording plan: primary recording goes to main server; mirror a local copy to SSD. Filenames: `allhands-2378904321-main.mkv` and `allhands-2378904321-local.mkv`. Start local recording ~90s before go-time.

caption-bot: Captions running en-US model with low-latency pipeline. If the live caption connection drops: Settings -> Export -> Save VTT. Keep last VTT on SSD under /media/ssd/captions/.

jordan: Posting the Q&A doc link now and will set the T-5 attendee reminder. During live Q&A please keep public answers concise; detailed follow-ups routed to #allhands-followup.

maria: Final ops checklist at T-2: ceiling cam tested, mic gains confirmed, SSD mounted and writable, OBS/encoder fallback scene loaded, captions status confirmed, Q&A doc posted. Ill post "ready" at T-2 here. If camera or mic failure occurs, call it in this thread and well flip sources. :thumbsup:
